findings.title: getCredentials dereferences myUser without a null check.
findings.body: `getMyUser(user)` returns null when the user is not in the provider's map, for example after the user is removed from the provider. The other methods guard against this (`isConfiguredFor`, `getDisableableCredentialTypesStream`). `getCredentials` reads `myUser.recoveryCodes` directly, so it throws a NullPointerException. That can happen when `getFederatedCredentialsStream()` is called for such a user, for example from the recovery-code authenticator or the login bean. Fix: return `Stream.empty()` when `myUser` is null.
